dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: I gave the bad Nara flowers. But I don't know who it was, because I don't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: But at that time, the bad Nara was definitely not bad yet.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Sometimes, when the bright moon rose, Nara was still a good child. But when the sun rose again, Nara became bad. I don't understand...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: #But no matter how many times the sun and moon rise and set, Nara {NICKNAME} will always be like Nara Varuna, shining like gold.
